title: The three projections are one irreducible structure

statements.text: An entity exists if and only if all three projections hold at once of the same constitutive activity. Stripping any one leaves no entity, so there is no partial entity: the projections are three readings of one structure, not three separable conditions.

sources.quote: An entity exists if and only if all three projections are satisfied simultaneously of the same constitutive activity.

sources.locator: section "The irreducibility of the three projections"
sources.quote: There is no partial entity under Constitutive Geometric Projection.
